final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT observstation, AVG(bandusagepct) as avg_bandwidth FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation), step2 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_bandwidth) as overall_avg FROM step1), step3 AS (SELECT step1.avg_bandwidth as A, step2.overall_avg as B, step1.avg_bandwidth - step2.overall_avg as A_minus_B FROM step1 CROSS JOIN step2 WHERE step2.overall_avg IS NOT NULL AND step1.avg_bandwidth IS NOT NULL AND step1.avg_bandwidth > step2.overall_avg) SELECT AVG(A) as avg_of_step1_averages, AVG(A_minus_B) as avg_of_differences FROM step3
